description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'PickerActivity' that provides a searchable list interface for selecting items, with asynchronous data loading and filtering.

classes.name: PickerActivity
classes.description: An abstract Android activity providing a searchable, selectable list with asynchronous data loading.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the list of items to display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, adapters, listeners, and starts data loading.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing data loading task when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: getSelectedString
methods.description: Retrieves the selected string from an Intent.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Gets the selected item string at a given position.

methods.name: onListItemClicked
methods.description: Handles list item click, returns selected item via Intent.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Filters and updates the list view based on current search input.
